text.en: Shoppers consistently praise the store staff and owners for their welcoming attitude and exceptional customer assistance. Reviewers note that the team readily assists with the self-wash stations and goes out of their way to order specific pet foods upon request. Pet parents highlight the attentive service that distinguishes this independent business.

Visitors highlight the dedicated self-service dog washing stations, noting that the grooming area is clean, tidy, and fully equipped with shampoos and towels. Pet owners also appreciate the broad product selection ranging from raw foods and fresh dog treats to supplies for reptiles, rabbits, and small animals. Convenient parking is also commended.

Clients note that retail prices for food, treats, and bathing station sessions remain fair and competitive with larger chain stores. Reviewers appreciate being able to support an independent neighbourhood shop without paying premium markups on staple items.

q.en: Does Furville have a self-service dog wash?

a.en: Yes, clients frequently mention the self-serve bathing stations, praising their cleanliness and stocked supplies.

q.en: Will the shop order specialty pet food upon request?

a.en: Yes, reviewers note that the owners happily order specific pet foods and treats for customers who ask.

q.en: Is parking available near the store?

a.en: Shoppers mention that convenient parking is accessible right by the shop along Ridge Avenue.

q.en: Does the store carry supplies for animals other than cats and dogs?

a.en: Yes, clients confirm finding items for rabbits, reptiles, and small exotic pets.
